name: KnowNote
description: Local-first desktop research workspace that turns your documents into a knowledge base with grounded answers.
whatItDoes: Lets you collect documents into notebooks and question them, with answers tied back to the source material. It is for individuals who want a NotebookLM-like tool on their own machine with their own model.
howItWorks: A desktop app performs retrieval over locally indexed documents and calls a user-supplied model. A notebook can also be served to a local agent through a read-only stdio MCP interface that uses the same retrieval path. Prebuilt releases are published; the README documents running from source.
